cartao.semPermissao: Your role does not allow viewing this card.
card.ts01.oQueMostra: How many tasks completed in the period go into this screen's calculations.
card.ts01.comoCalcula: Counts the tasks with a done status and a resolution, resolved in the period, with consistent dates and within your view. The types and statuses that the card sheet excludes are left out.
card.ts02.oQueMostra: What share of the analyzed tasks' time was spent in active statuses.
card.ts02.comoCalcula: Time in active statuses ÷ total time outside done, summed over the analyzed tasks. Opening the card shows the analyzed tasks, which make up the numerator and the denominator.
card.ts03.oQueMostra: Open tasks stuck in their current status beyond what is normal for that status.
card.ts03.comoCalcula: Open for more than 1.5 × the status median (at least 2 days, in the chosen unit); the median comes from the tasks completed in the period.
card.ts04.oQueMostra: Median and P85 of the time completed tasks spent in each status.
card.ts04.comoCalcula: For each status, sums the stays per task (re-entries add up) and computes the median and P85 across the analyzed tasks; n is the number of tasks that went through the status.
card.ts05.oQueMostra: The relative weight of each status in the tasks' time, to find where they wait.
card.ts05.comoCalcula: Bar proportional to each status median, compared with the largest P85; same base and same n as the Time per status card.
card.ts06.oQueMostra: Median days of each person in each status, in alphabetical order and with no ranking.
card.ts06.comoCalcula: For each person and status, the median time the person was the assignee, across the analyzed tasks; n is the number of tasks. Bands: up to 3 days, 3 to 6 days, over 6 days.
card.ts07.oQueMostra: List of the open tasks stuck beyond normal.
card.ts07.comoCalcula: Same rule as the Stuck beyond normal card: time in the current status compared with the status median. The screen lists up to 50; the number counts all of them.
card.sy01.oQueMostra: Whether the panel is syncing with Jira or is switched off by the flag.
card.sy01.comoCalcula: Read from the configuration: periodic when the Jira flag is on, off when it is not. Only the user turns the flag on.
card.sy02.oQueMostra: The latest synchronizer runs for each instance, with counts and result.
card.sy02.comoCalcula: Read from the local database run log (up to 10 per instance): type, status, start, end, issues, events, requests and error code.
card.sy03.oQueMostra: The last local cleanup of old data.
card.sy03.comoCalcula: Read from the retention run log. The cleanup only deletes local data and never talks to Jira.
